d:
The Raipur–Visakhapatnam Expressway is one of India’s biggest upcoming infrastructure projects, connecting Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and Andhra Pradesh. In this video, we cover the complete route, twin tunnels, wildlife corridors, entry-exit points, and current construction progress.
What’s Covered in this Video:
Starting & ending points of the expressway
Distance & travel time reduction
Route details in Chhattisgarh, Odisha & Andhra Pradesh
Twin tunnels in Chhattisgarh & Odisha
Wildlife corridors, animal crossings & monkey canopies
Entry & exit points across the 464 km stretch
